title: معالجة: Absence of Structured Data Markup on Service Page
technical_problem: The /services page does not implement JSON-LD structured data (such as Service or WebPage schema). While missing structured data is not an explicit technical error, schema markup helps search engines interpret page entity attributes more effectively.
proposed_fix: Assess adding Service or WebPage structured data using JSON-LD to clearly define offered capabilities.
implementation_guidance: تطبيق الإصلاح التقني في الخادم أو كود القوالب HTML، ثم التحقق عبر إرسال طلب فحص مباشر.
expected_technical_benefit: التأثير على تجربة الزوار أو فاعلية الفهرسة.
limitations: يتطلب التحقق النهائي فحص الاستجابة الحية عبر أداة فحص العناوين في Google Search Console.

title: معالجة: Unspecified Language and Internationalization Metadata
technical_problem: Content on the site is written in Arabic, but explicit hreflang annotations were not detected in the provided page crawl data.
proposed_fix: Verify that the HTML lang attribute is set to 'ar' and determine if multi-regional targeting via hreflang is necessary.
